headline: Bitcoin is holding near $81,500 on a quiet Friday after US bitcoin funds had their biggest one-day outflow since June, with next week's Fed decision now in focus.

market.asOf: Read from CoinMarketCap's homepage at about 16:00 UTC 23 Oct (23:00 Bangkok); CoinGecko showed BTC about $81,495 at the same time. Live prices are at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 68, Greed (alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index); CoinMarketCap's own index reads 48, Neutral. Two different indices.

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs post their biggest one-day outflow since June, but the week is still positive
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs, funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors, saw $635.6 million leave on Thursday 22 Oct, more than wiping out Wednesday's inflow. Friday's numbers are not out yet, and the week as a whole is still positive, per The Block.
points: Net outflow of $635.6M on Thursday, the largest daily outflow since June, per The Block.
By fund: BlackRock's IBIT -$254.1M, Fidelity's FBTC -$217.5M, ARK's ARKB -$109.4M; Morgan Stanley's MSBT took in $2.3M, per The Block.
The week so far is still about +$442.7M net, per The Block.
Spot ether ETFs lost $110.6M on Thursday after taking in $14.9M the day before, per The Block.

sources.label: The Block: Bitcoin ETFs swing back to net outflows

stories.title: Bitcoin holds a tight range near $81,500 as stocks slip and oil climbs
stories.summary: After Thursday's tech-stock sell-off, bitcoin has stayed in a narrow range on Friday, just below a level it lost on Thursday. US stocks opened lower again and oil is near its highest since May.
points: CoinDesk's live blog (7:13am ET) had bitcoin near $81,500, down 0.4% over 24 hours and still below $82,500, the level it lost on Thursday.
Thursday's low: $80,790 at 12:50pm ET per Bitcoin News Digest; CoinDesk says bitcoin dipped to about $81,000 late Thursday.
At Friday's open, the S&P 500 slipped 0.48%, the Dow 0.97% and the Nasdaq 0.34%, per TheStreet.
Oil: WTI crude rose 1.56% to $101 and Brent 1.17% to $114.50 early Friday, per TheStreet; CoinDesk says Brent touched its highest since early May.

sources.label: CoinDesk: Live updates, bitcoin holds above $81,000

stories.title: Washington: a Senate probe into Tether payments, a stalled crypto bill, and SEC exams flag tokenization
stories.summary: Sen. Richard Blumenthal wrote to Tether and to Nxum Group, a firm tied to former White House crypto adviser Bo Hines, asking for records about payments between them; these are questions based on press reports, not findings. JPMorgan expects the CLARITY Act market-structure bill to stall, leaving US crypto rules to agencies. And on Friday the SEC's 2027 exam priorities named tokenization as a risk area.
points: The senator's release cites reporting that over $6M went from Tether to Nxum, that Tether agreed to pay Nxum $415,000 a month, and that Tether plans to buy a 25% stake for $56M.
The release asks for responses by 6 Nov 2026.

JPMorgan sees the CLARITY Act as unlikely to pass this year and possibly returning in 2027, and warns agency actions could be overturned in as soon as two years if a Democrat wins the White House, per The Block.
The SEC's FY2027 exam priorities list tokenization among market-infrastructure risks and create no new legal obligations, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Franklin Templeton registers two bitcoin 'DRIP' ETFs
briefs.summary: The funds would hold 95% US stocks and 5% bitcoin exposure at a 0.09% fee; no launch date yet, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Malaysia and Thailand join Singapore's BLOOM stablecoin payments project
briefs.summary: The project, which includes Ripple, Visa and Mastercard, tests cross-border payments with stablecoins and tokenized deposits.

briefs.summary: The New York attorney general says NovaTech was a pyramid scheme that took about $1.16B in crypto deposits.

briefs.summary: RedCoin works through HSBC's PayMe app, which can pay over 100,000 merchants, per The Block.

briefs.title: India's CoinDCX denies a new hack after about $16M left old wallets
briefs.summary: The exchange calls the addresses deprecated; on-chain investigator ZachXBT says one interacted with a current CoinDCX hot wallet as recently as April and May 2026.

briefs.title: Arkadiko, a DeFi app on Stacks, hit by a governance attack
briefs.summary: About 2 million stSTX and 1.65 sBTC were removed, value locked fell about 90%, and its USDA stablecoin lost its peg, per The Crypto Times.

briefs.title: Coinbase Ireland fined about $3.6M
briefs.summary: The Central Bank of Ireland fined it over customer-fund safeguarding failures.
